basics.name: Anushree Ganta
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary: Frontend Developer with technical expertise in building high-performance, responsive web applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, and component-driven architecture. Skilled in Core Web Vitals optimization, state management, and enterprise API integration.

work.name: Google (via GlobalLogic)
work.summary: Architected a scalable frontend platform, data visualization dashboards, and automated PLM workflows powering Google's Global Supply Management operations.
highlights: Architected a modular frontend web platform for Google’s Global Supply Management ecosystem using Appmaker, modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and component-driven UI architecture.
Engineered enterprise analytics dashboards for cost modeling and supplier intelligence, modernizing legacy infrastructure and boosting system reliability by 35%.
Built high-throughput data pipelines and automated PLM workflows integrating BigQuery, Cloud SQL, PLX, Google Apps Script, and Tableau.

work.name: eDiligence
work.summary: Engineered interactive data visualization dashboards and modular client-side architectures to track real-time agile development metrics.
highlights: Architected an interactive Agile analytics platform using React.js, Redux, and D3.js, visualizing complex sprint velocity and project telemetry with dynamic chart rendering.
Designed component-driven UI library leveraging Material-UI (MUI), React Router, and CSS3 for single-page application (SPA) routing.
Built a high-performance Node.js & Express REST API tier integrated with MongoDB, implementing NoSQL schema optimization for low-latency data retrieval.

work.name: Accenture Pvt. Ltd.
work.summary: Spearheaded frontend feature development, UI component modularization, and web performance optimization for enterprise eCommerce platforms.
highlights: Engineered interactive analytics dashboards in React.js featuring customizable drag-and-drop UI components and CSS Flexbox/Grid layouts.
Optimized enterprise eCommerce frontend web applications using modern JavaScript (ES6+), Core-JS polyfills, and jQuery, resolving cross-browser compatibility bottlenecks.
Implemented Real User Monitoring (RUM) using Boomerang.js, analyzing Core Web Vitals to optimize page load speeds by 25%.

projects.name: Blink – Anonymous Workplace Community Platform
projects.description: A distributed, responsive web application for workplace discussions and anonymous telemetry.
highlights: Architected a responsive web client using React.js, Redux, and CSS Grid, establishing accessible, mobile-first component layouts.
Implemented decoupled message queue middleware to handle real-time feed updates and scalable horizontal message rendering.

projects.name: Online Banking Web Application
projects.description: A secure, multi-role financial application supporting real-time transaction workflows.
highlights: Developed customer and admin portals using React.js, Redux, and interactive React-Draggable UI components.
Integrated 256-bit AES encryption and secure client authentication for low-latency payment processing.
